title: Resolve bridge edit spec
description: The declarative contract between tools that assemble an edit and the Resolve bridge (`build` consumes it, `export-spec` produces it). Bespoke JSON modeled on OpenTimelineIO vocabulary; NOT raw OTIO. Time is INTEGER FRAMES at the spec's `rate` - never float seconds. Every edit must be pre-resolved into append-time geometry: the Resolve API cannot trim/move/razor/retime a placed clip (no post-placement edits). Validate it before `build` and after `export-spec`.

format.description: Assembler format that produced/consumes this spec, or 'export' for a bridge-read serialization.

rate.description: Timeline frame rate (conventional integer: 23.976->24, 29.97->30). All frame numbers in this document are at this rate. null is legal ONLY in format:'export' documents when the setting was unreadable (see generator.warnings); build-time specs MUST carry an integer.

start_frame.description: Timeline start timecode as frames (Resolve timelines commonly start at 108000 = 01:00:00:00 @30fps).

tracks.description: Track role -> ordered clip entries. Roles are V1..Vn (video, bottom-up) and A1..An (audio).

overlays.description: Typed section for treatments OTIO has no home for (captions, grade, sound design plans).

from.description: Source field for timing, e.g. 'vo_words' (the words array).

words.description: Frame-quantized word timings (WhisperX es), feeding kinetic-captions and title sync.

markers.description: Timeline markers keyed by frame (export passthrough of Resolve GetMarkers()).

generator.description: Provenance of this document (tool, cli build, project).

clip.description: One placed item. Build-time entries carry src+in/out+record geometry; overlay entries carry overlay/template fields; export entries may omit build-only fields.

id.description: Stable clip id, unique within the spec.

src.description: Media path (or media pool clip name for generated items).

duration.description: Frames (export convenience; dur is the build-time field).

overlay.description: Overlay kind for V2+ items, e.g. 'title'.
